findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

Multiple employees were observed to don gloves and begin food service without hand washing. Education was conducted with the manager and they were instructed to review hand washing with all food handlers and enforce good hand washing practices moving forward.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple dishes were observed stored while soiled with food debris and sticker residue. The PIC was shown and moved the items back to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained clean until use.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

Mops were observed with the heads pooled up in the bottoms of the empty mop buckets. The PIC was shown and instructed to store the mops so that the bristles are allowed to hang and drip dry. Ensure mops are stored correctly moving forward. THe mops were moved by the inspector during the inspection to demonstrate and corrected the violation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

Multiple locations throughout the facility were observed with the coving at the floor junction pulling away from the wall. This is exposing a gap that it not easily cleanable by staff. The PIC was shown and instructed to have the location re-sealed prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the fountain drink machine are observed soiled. The PIC was shown and had an employee clean them (wash/rinse/sanitize) during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. 

TCS food in the reach in cooler next to the fryers are observed with internal temperatures of 67F. The PIC was shown and discarded the foods in the cooler to correct the immediate violation. Investigation showed that the breaker had been tripped. The breaker was reset and the cooler observed at acceptable temperature by the end of the inspection. A spot check will be conducted next week to ensure that this is an isolated event only.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

1) A mop is observed stored with the head pooled up in the bottom of the mop sink. 2) A mop is observed stored in heavily soiled water in a mop bucket. The PIC was shown and instructed to store the mops so that the bristles are allowed to hang and drip dry. Ensure mops are stored correctly moving forward.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

Multiple flies are observed throughout the facility during this inspection. The PIC was shown as they were observed and instructed to remove the pests prior to the follow up scheduled in two weeks.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. 

The faucet for the hand sink next to the office is observed with two sections that appear to have degraded, leaving a caveat that is not easily cleanable. The PIC is instructed to repair/seal/replace prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

There is a large accumulation of ice on the floor under the shelves in the walk in freezer. Clean the floors often enough and sufficiently to ensure that nothing accumulates on them that prevents effective cleaning. The PIC was shown and instructed to maintain clean.
